mathematical_checks: Every F_n is the real degree5p^n subfield and its unique p-prime is generated by the norm of1-zeta.
The cyclic norm-residue product formula and Hasse norm theorem imply every base unit is a norm of an element.
The maximal genus field is F_nH_0 by a central cyclic-quotient and inertia argument, proving |A_n^G|=|A0| directly.
The full ambiguous-to-unit map, surjectivity via the fractional-ideal permutation module, and strongly ambiguous kernel are proved.
Principal ramified primes give [E0:N E_n]=|ker j_n| with no tame-prime assumption.
Ichimura one-prime criterion applies; Remark1(1) plus total ramification identifies auxiliary degrees with |A_n|, and Remark1(2) gives boundedness equivalence.
